reuse.why: Selects categories with the shared categoriesForMonthBudgetAction and signs the amount with amountForAverageBudget, as the existing month-wide actions do, and registers with mutator(undoable(...)); it copies the category query rather than sharing a loader.

duplication.why: The categories-with-group-hidden SQL is pasted once more (now five copies in actions.ts) instead of being pulled into a shared loader; the eligibility and sign rules themselves are not duplicated.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts beside the other month-wide actions and is registered in budget/app.ts next to them.

scope.why: Besides the new action it reformats the type annotations of setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg and adds a blank line in the imports, unrelated churn.

maintainability.why: The new action follows the established pattern and shares the rules; the extra query copy keeps the tree's existing smell.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Category selection and amount sign both go through the shared month-budget-categories helpers.

disguised_duplication.where: The query is copied verbatim from setZero.
